worker_return.answer: OpenHarness is a Python agent-harness package with CLI entrypoints, provider/auth plumbing, streaming query execution, tool registry, permissions, MCP, skills/plugins, memory/context, sandboxing, background tasks, swarm/subagent coordination, a React/Ink terminal frontend, and a separate ohmo personal-agent app. For integrated-engine continuity, the most useful internal lens material is the real worker/session boundary around CLI print/task-worker modes, QueryEngine/run_query, tool execution, permission checking, BackgroundTaskManager, AgentTool, and SubprocessBackend.
findings: The package is distributed as openharness-ai version 0.1.6 with console scripts openharness, oh, openh, and ohmo.
README frames OpenHarness as lightweight agent infrastructure for tool use, skills, memory, governance, and multi-agent coordination.
QueryEngine and run_query are central model/tool loop surfaces binding API streaming, tools, permissions, hooks, compaction, and message state.
BaseTool and ToolRegistry define the normalized tool abstraction and API schema projection.
PermissionChecker is relevant boundary material because it combines sensitive-path hard denies, allow/deny lists, read-only allowance, plan mode blocking, and default confirmation.
BackgroundTaskManager, AgentTool, and SubprocessBackend are the strongest next inspection targets for real worker and subagent lifecycle comparison.
ohmo is a separate personal-agent layer with gateway/channel integrations built on OpenHarness.
